title: Nigeria Confirms First Ebola Case as Outbreak Spreads
subtitle: Health authorities are working to track contacts after a woman tests positive for the virus in Abuja.

summary.en: Nigeria has officially confirmed its first case of Ebola in the capital city of Abuja. A woman who traveled from Uganda tested positive for the virus after showing symptoms earlier this month. Health officials are now tracing 44 people who had contact with the patient to prevent further spread. This development comes as the current Ebola outbreak spreads across multiple African regions. Experts warn that this is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak ever recorded.
summary.zh: 奈及利亞已正式證實首都阿布加出現首例伊波拉病例。一名從烏干達入境的女性在本月初出現症狀後，經檢測確認感染該病毒。衛生官員目前正追蹤四十四名曾與該病患接觸的人員，以防止疫情進一步擴散。此發展正值伊波拉疫情在多個非洲區域蔓延之際。專家警告，這是史上傳播速度最快的伊波拉疫情。

paragraphs.en: Nigeria has confirmed its first case of the Ebola virus in its capital, Abuja. According to The Guardian World and NPR News, the patient is a woman who arrived in the country from Uganda. She began showing symptoms on October 7 and was admitted to a hospital four days later. It was at this hospital that doctors confirmed she had the virus. The Nigerian government has not shared the nationality of the woman, and it remains unclear exactly when she arrived in the country.
paragraphs.zh: 奈及利亞已證實其首都阿布加出現首例伊波拉病毒病例。根據《衛報》國際版與美國國家公共廣播電台報導，該名病患為一名從烏干達入境的女性。她於十月七日開始出現症狀，四天後入院治療。院方醫師隨後證實她感染了該病毒。奈及利亞政府並未透露該名女性的國籍，目前也不清楚她確切的入境時間。

paragraphs.en: Ebola is a dangerous virus that causes severe illness. Health experts are very concerned because this specific type, known as the Bundibugyo virus, is spreading quickly. Dr. Jean Kaseya, the director general of the Africa Centers for Disease Control, described the situation as an extremely serious threat. He noted that the virus has a fatality rate—the percentage of people who die after catching the disease—of nearly 50 percent. This current outbreak is now the most geographically extensive in history, meaning it has spread across more areas than any previous outbreak.
paragraphs.zh: 伊波拉是一種會導致嚴重疾病的危險病毒。衛生專家對此深感憂心，因為這種被稱為「邦迪布焦病毒」的特定類型正迅速擴散。非洲疾病管制中心主任尚·卡塞亞博士形容此情況為極度嚴重的威脅。他指出，該病毒的致死率（即感染後死亡的人數比例）接近百分之五十。目前的疫情是歷史上地理範圍最廣的一次，意味著它擴散的區域比以往任何一次疫情都還要多。

paragraphs.en: In response to the news, Nigerian Health Minister Muhammad Pate announced that authorities have started the process of contact tracing. This is a method used by health officials to identify and monitor everyone who has been near an infected person to stop the virus from spreading further. Minister Pate stated that they are currently tracking 44 people who may have had contact with the patient. The government is doing everything possible to contain the case and keep the public safe.
paragraphs.zh: 針對此消息，奈及利亞衛生部長穆罕默德·佩特宣布，當局已啟動接觸者追蹤程序。這是衛生官員用來識別並監控所有曾與感染者接觸過的人員，以阻止病毒進一步擴散的方法。佩特部長表示，他們目前正在追蹤四十四名可能與該病患有過接觸的人員。政府正竭盡所能控制此病例，以確保大眾安全。

paragraphs.en: Uganda’s ministry of health has commented on the situation, stating that the woman only passed through their country during her travels. They insisted that the location where she caught the virus is still under investigation and noted that Uganda does not currently have any active cases of Ebola. The situation is part of a larger regional health challenge. Kenya also recently confirmed its first case of the virus earlier this month and has since recorded nine infections.
paragraphs.zh: 烏干達衛生部對此情況發表評論，表示該名女性僅是在旅途中經過該國。他們堅稱她感染病毒的地點仍在調查中，並指出烏干達目前沒有任何現存的伊波拉病例。此情況屬於區域性健康挑戰的一部分。肯亞本月初也證實出現首例病毒感染，至今已累計九起病例。

paragraphs.en: To prepare for this potential health crisis, the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control had already been working to improve its surveillance and readiness. Their efforts include early detection, which means finding the virus as soon as possible, and isolation, which is the act of keeping sick people away from others to prevent transmission. They are also focusing on laboratory testing and protecting health care workers who are on the front lines of the response. Nigeria established a special task force in June to address these risks after an outbreak began in Congo in mid-May.
paragraphs.zh: 為了應對這場潛在的健康危機，奈及利亞疾病管制中心早已致力於提升監測與準備工作。他們的努力包括早期偵測（即盡快發現病毒）以及隔離（將病患與他人隔開以防止傳播）。他們也專注於實驗室檢測，並保護站在防疫第一線的醫療人員。在剛果於五月中旬爆發疫情後，奈及利亞已於六月成立特別工作小組來應對這些風險。

paragraphs.en: Femi Gbajabiamila, the chief of staff to Nigeria’s president, explained that the country has been working hard to build structures to address these threats. He noted that they do not want a repeat of past experiences where the country had to scramble to respond to a sudden arrival of the virus. The government wants to ensure that they are ready to handle any potential spread before it becomes a larger problem.
paragraphs.zh: 奈及利亞總統幕僚長費米·格巴賈比亞米拉解釋說，該國一直努力建立架構以應對這些威脅。他指出，他們不希望重蹈覆轍，再次面臨因病毒突然出現而手忙腳亂的情況。政府希望確保在問題擴大前，已準備好處理任何潛在的擴散風險。

paragraphs.en: This current situation is particularly worrying for health authorities because of how fast the virus is moving. According to reports from NPR News, this is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record. It is currently on track to exceed the death toll of the 2014-2016 outbreak in West Africa, which resulted in 11,000 deaths. As countries across the region continue to monitor the situation, the focus remains on stopping the chain of infection through quick action and careful tracking of all potential contacts.
paragraphs.zh: 由於病毒傳播速度極快，目前的情況令衛生當局格外擔憂。根據美國國家公共廣播電台的報導，這是史上傳播速度最快的伊波拉疫情。目前的疫情發展趨勢恐將超越二零一四至二零一六年西非疫情的死亡人數，當時該次疫情造成了一萬一千人死亡。隨著該區域各國持續監控局勢，防疫重點仍放在透過迅速行動與仔細追蹤所有潛在接觸者，以切斷感染鏈。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Making progress and likely to achieve a specific result or outcome.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 進展順利，預期會達成某種結果。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常被誤解為「在軌道上」，這裡指「預計會發生」。文中：It is currently on track to exceed the death toll of the 2014-2016 outbreak in West Africa, which resulted in 11,000 deaths.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To move or act quickly and with difficulty, often because of an urgent situation.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 倉促行動，手忙腳亂地應對。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（炒蛋），這裡指緊急且混亂的行動。文中：He noted that they do not want a repeat of past experiences where the country had to scramble to respond to a sudden arrival of the virus.

keyTerms.definitionEn: The most important or active position in a situation, especially in a dangerous or difficult task.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 最前線，指直接面對困難或危險的第一線人員。
keyTerms.noteZh: 原為軍事用語，這裡引申為抗疫的第一線工作者。文中：They are also focusing on laboratory testing and protecting health care workers who are on the front lines of the response.

quiz.question: How long after the patient began showing symptoms was she admitted to a hospital?

options.A: On the same day she arrived in Nigeria

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，病患於 10 月 7 日出現症狀，並在四天後（four days later）入院。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章提到抵達時間不明。選項 C 混淆了日期與時間間隔。選項 D 錯誤，因為接觸者追蹤是在入院後才開始的過程。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about Nigeria's current readiness to handle the Ebola virus compared to previous years?

options.A: Nigeria is currently unprepared and scrambling to respond to the sudden arrival
options.B: The government believes the virus will not spread beyond the initial 44 contacts
options.C: Nigeria has proactively established systems to manage the threat before it escalates
options.D: The government is relying solely on international aid from Uganda and Kenya

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第五段與第六段，奈及利亞早在六月就成立專責小組，並致力於提升監控與準備工作，目的是避免過去那種「手忙腳亂（scramble）」的應對方式。選項 A 正好與文章描述的「已做好準備」相反。選項 B 文中未提及，且疫情擴散難以預測。選項 D 錯誤，因為文章強調的是奈及利亞自身的監控與應對努力。

quiz.question: In the sixth paragraph, what does the word 'scramble' mean in the context of the government's response?

options.A: To act in a disorganized and hurried way due to lack of preparation
options.B: To cook food using a rapid heating method
options.C: To climb over obstacles to reach a destination
options.D: To change the order of information to keep it secret

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文中提到政府不希望重蹈覆轍，再次被迫「scramble」來應對突發狀況，這意指在毫無準備的情況下倉促、混亂地行動。選項 B 是該詞的字面義（炒蛋），在此不適用。選項 C 是該詞的物理動作義，與行政應對無關。選項 D 為錯誤解釋，與文中語境完全不符。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of the article regarding the Ebola situation in Nigeria?

options.A: The history of the Ebola virus in West Africa since 2014
options.B: A detailed medical analysis of the symptoms caused by the Bundibugyo virus
options.C: The diplomatic tension between Nigeria and Uganda regarding the virus
options.D: Nigeria's strategic efforts to contain the current Ebola outbreak through surveillance and tracking

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。本文主旨圍繞奈及利亞出現首例伊波拉病毒後，政府如何透過接觸者追蹤、監控與防疫準備來遏止疫情擴散。選項 A 僅是背景資訊，非文章重點。選項 B 文章僅概略提到嚴重性，並非醫學分析報告。選項 C 錯誤，文中僅說明烏干達澄清病患僅是過境，並未描述兩國間有外交緊張關係。
